name: Vromma Miretongue
source_profile: ● Lady Vromma Miretongue (LN) is the court's chief minister, who handles most practical matters of government. She maintains records of tribute, mediates disputes, and attempts to restrain the king's worst excesses.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 55 (source excerpt; may be partial)
